note: G_ij is the free Maxwell correlation of the j-th basis label with row i's optional basis spectator at the row's configuration, which is SampleRow.tests on the standard table with Columns' real basis. [L] allows one- and two-point rows exactly as [M] does, so only the table being a parameter differs.

snippet.text:
structure Columns (S : Table C.book) (d : ℕ) where
  dim : ℕ
  H : (standard C).RealSpin
  basis : Module.Basis (Fin (dim+1)) ℂ ((standard C).Field d)
  realBasis i : (standard C).conj H d (basis i) = basis i
  initial : basis 0 = (standard C).unit d
  amount : ℕ
  row : Fin amount → SampleRow (Fin (dim+1))
  full : Injective (fun x => (fun i => (row i).tests (standard C) basis x))
